falseFriends.station: Use 'работна станция' for workstation, not 'станция' (train/power station)
falseFriends.shift: Use 'смяна' for work shift, not 'шифт' (keyboard Shift key only)

grammarNotes.noCase: Bulgarian has lost most case distinctions (unique among Slavic). Uses prepositional constructions: 'ефективността на оборудването'.
grammarNotes.postposedArticle: Definite article postposed: 'наличност' → 'наличността'. Critical for UI: label vs instruction forms.
grammarNotes.cyrillicScript: Uses Cyrillic. No Latin alternative (unlike Serbian). Uses 'Ъ' (back vowel).
grammarNotes.verbAspect: Perfective imperative for buttons: 'Запази' (save). Imperfective for ongoing: 'Машината работи'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Bulgarian uses prepositional 'за/на' constructions (no case system). In compound phrases, the modifier noun after the preposition should stay SINGULAR when naming a concept. CORRECT: 'причини за загуба на скорост' (reasons for loss [sg] of speed). CHECK: 'причини за загуби на скорост' — 'загуби' is plural, which incorrectly implies individual loss events rather than the concept of speed loss.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE is commonly used. Full Bulgarian term: 'Обща Ефективност на Оборудването'.
industryContext.emergingHub: Bulgaria is an emerging SE Europe manufacturing hub with Western European FDI

commonMistakes: Using 'шифт' for work shift instead of 'смяна'
Mixing Russian Cyrillic forms with Bulgarian

Pluralizing the modifier in compound noun phrases: 'причини за загуби на скорост' (WRONG — 'загуби' is plural) instead of 'причини за загуба на скорост' (CORRECT — 'загуба' stays singular as it names the concept). Only the head noun should pluralize
notes: OEE is used; Bulgarian uses Cyrillic. Unusually for Slavic, has postposed article and minimal case system. P95 expansion 2.06x.
